title: Gate a VCF Automation deployment rename on its name precheck
prompt:
Before implementing, research the version-specific VCF Automation 9.0 xAPIs reference pages on developer.broadcom.com for Check Deployment Name Exists and Patch Deployment. Confirm their methods, paths, parameters, request and response schemas, statuses, and authentication, and cite the exact official URLs consulted in the final answer.

Implement the deployment rename client in this repository using only the Go standard library. Complete `(*Client).RenameDeployment` in `vcfautomation/client.go`. A rename is a gated two-request workflow. First issue `GET /deployment/api/deployments/names` with the requested name in the required `name` query parameter. HTTP 404 means the name is available and the rename may proceed. HTTP 200 means the name already exists: return an error satisfying `errors.Is(err, ErrNameConflict)` and do not issue a PATCH. Any other precheck status or transport error must also return an error and issue no PATCH, but must not report `ErrNameConflict`.

Only after the 404 precheck response, issue `PATCH /deployment/api/deployments/{deploymentId}`. Both requests use bearer authentication and accept JSON. The bodyless precheck must not declare a content type. The PATCH must use `application/json` and always include `name`. Include `description` and `iconId` only when their pointers in `UpdateOptions` are non-nil; nil options must be omitted, not encoded as empty strings or null. A non-nil pointer is explicit and must be encoded even when it points to an empty string. URL-encode the name query value. Decode and return the deployment from a successful PATCH response, and return errors for non-2xx PATCH responses or malformed response JSON.

Add table-driven tests for the implementation. Do not modify `go.mod`. Run `go test -race ./...`. Verification checks request ordering and the exact request method, target, query encoding, authorization, headers, and body, including omission of unset optional fields and the absence of a mutating request whenever the precheck fails.
